args.answer:
In your setup — underground garage in 94158 with no outlet near your space — Cormorant cannot do an interior clean down there.

* What you want = their interior detail, sold as The Cutter: vacuum seats/carpets/mats/trunk, wipe dash/console/door panels, inside glass and spot-clean. No shampoo, pet-hair removal or exterior work included.
* Power rule: interior detail, full detail and The Flagship need a grounded 120-volt outlet within 75 feet of the vehicle, or a $30 generator fee. Because the generator can't run in an enclosed or underground garage, those services can't be done there without an outlet. Only the exterior wash needs no power.
  So no — they cannot just bring a generator to your underground space. You would need an accessible outlet within 75 ft, or a different location: driveway, private lot, open garage or street space that stays legal for the whole job, with 3 ft clear on both sides, plus room within 100 ft for their 20-ft long, 7-ft 2-in tall work van.

* Building manager: that's on you. A customer parked at an apartment / condo / HOA-managed lot must get the building manager's permission before booking. Cormorant doesn't contact managers, and a refusal on the day counts as a no-show (deposit kept).

Other notes for you:
* Your ZIP 94158 is in their no-travel-fee San Francisco zone.
* Your RAV4 is not named on their size list. Their midsize class (Class B) covers sedans, crossovers and two-row SUVs such as Camry, Model 3/Y, CR-V or Outback — if your RAV4 is classed as midsize, interior is $179 before add-ons/fees/tax. A technician checks size class before starting and shows photos/new price if it differs; if you decline, no job and no deposit back. Ask them to confirm RAV4 = midsize when you contact them.

What would make it possible: an outdoor / open-air spot with manager permission + outlet within 75 ft (or generator allowed outdoors for $30), with legal parking and clearances above.
